title: Conversion Charges on Small and Mid-Size Payout Methods Transfers
content:
How the conversion charge on a Payout Methods transfer paid out in a currency other than USD is formed follows the size of the transfer, because a percentage of a small conversion does not cover the cost of converting it. The size is the USD amount of the transfer the conversion fee names.

## Rule

- A transfer **below USD 250.00** is charged the flat **USD 4.00** in place of the percentage charge.
- A transfer of **at least USD 250.00 and below USD 1000.00** is charged the **greater** of the capped percentage charge and the minimum of **USD 9.00**.
- A transfer of **USD 1000.00 or more** is charged the capped percentage charge as it stands.

The capped percentage charge is the transfer amount multiplied by the percentage applied to the transfer, divided by one hundred, cut to the rail's highest cross-currency fee where that figure is above 0.00.

## Decision table

| Transfer amount (USD) | Conversion charge |
|---|---|
| 0.01 to 249.99 | USD 4.00 flat |
| 250.00 to 999.99 | The greater of the capped percentage charge and USD 9.00 |
| 1000.00 and above | The capped percentage charge |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical transfers on a rail charging 2.00% with no cap)

| Transfer | Capped percentage charge | Band | Conversion charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 249.99 | USD 4.9998 | Below USD 250.00 | USD 4.00 |
| USD 250.00 | USD 5.00 | USD 250.00 up to USD 1000.00 | USD 9.00, the minimum being greater |
| USD 450.00 | USD 9.00 | USD 250.00 up to USD 1000.00 | USD 9.00, the two being equal |
| USD 800.00 | USD 16.00 | USD 250.00 up to USD 1000.00 | USD 16.00, the percentage charge being greater |
| USD 999.99 | USD 19.9998 | USD 250.00 up to USD 1000.00 | USD 19.9998 |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 1000.00 or more | USD 20.00 |

The conversion charge in each line is carried unrounded.

## Basis questions

- *Is the flat USD 4.00 added to the percentage charge?* No. Below USD 250.00 it is charged in place of the percentage charge.
- *Is the USD 9.00 minimum compared with the charge before or after the rail's cap?* After: it is compared with the capped percentage charge.
- *Does the minimum reach a transfer of USD 1000.00?* No. From USD 1000.00 the capped percentage charge stands as it is.
